sources.vegetation-states.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game vegetation sprite sheet, ORIGINAL painted dark-fantasy art, true TRANSPARENT RGBA background, 1536x1536. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, sixteen separate isolated clumps, one per cell, full uncropped silhouettes, no labels, grid, ground plane, pots, rocks, or shadow beneath. Elevated frontal orthographic game camera, see tops and sides, natural broad brushwork and fine tips, not pixel art. Each three consecutive cells are the SAME vegetation species in three VERY DISTINCT states: first DENSE TALL UPRIGHT unbroken growth with high vertical silhouette; second STILL TALL LIVING growth visibly PARTED DOWN THE CENTER, stalks bent outward forming a clear V with exposed cut tips, lower and sparser but NOT dead; third FLATTENED TRAMPLED grass with severed horizontal straw and tiny low stubble, low wide silhouette. Exact row-major cell order: 1 sewers tall deep green reeds with pale olive tips; 2 sewers tall parted reeds with pale yellow-green inner stalks and strong V silhouette; 3 sewers flattened dull ochre-green reed clippings. 4 prison tall cool blue-green wiry grass. 5 prison parted blue-green wiry grass with silvery cut stems and clear V; 6 prison flattened grey-green clippings. 7 caves tall dense sage fern and coarse grasses with pale tips; 8 caves parted sage fern with exposed warm ochre stems and clear V; 9 caves flattened tan fern fronds and short stubble. 10 ancient city tall muted violet-green ornamental blades; 11 city parted violet blades with pale lavender edges and clear V; 12 city flattened grey-violet clippings. 13 demon halls tall ash-grey reedlike fungal stems and small rusty red caps; 14 halls parted ash-grey stems and sparse pale ivory caps with a clear V; 15 halls flattened pale grey fibrous clippings. 16 a spare small low dark moss tuft. All cells separated with transparent gutters of at least 10%. No soil base: transparency between blades and below the roots. The tall clumps must have height exceeding width; the flattened clumps width exceeding height. Material contrast and silhouettes must remain distinct at a 64 pixel destination size. No borrowed game designs.
sources.door-states.png: Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL painted dark fantasy game door sprite production sheet. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, 2048x1024, genuine transparent RGBA outside each isolated object. No backdrop, floor tile, text, grid, dropped shadow or checkerboard. Smooth realistic hand-painted aged oak, forged iron, worn pale grey limestone, broad readable planes, soft neutral light from upper left. Elevated frontal orthographic dungeon view, not an isometric diamond, no pixel art. TOP ROW: four aligned views of the EXACT SAME narrow rectangular stone doorframe with identical frame width, height and threshold. Cell1 closed dark walnut vertical-board door reinforced with two horizontal black iron bands and small brass ring handle. Cell2 the same door fully OPEN: empty transparent doorway with unobstructed entrance, door leaf rotated tightly alongside the RIGHT jamb as a narrow edge, no diagonal plank across the opening. Cell3 the same closed door with a prominent square brass padlock at its center. Cell4 the same stone frame enclosing a translucent frosted pale cyan crystal door slab and silver braces, distinct from wood. All four stone lintels, left and right jambs, and narrow bottom thresholds exactly align. Door occupies its whole narrow frame. BOTTOM ROW: matching slim SIDE-ON door leaves without the stone frame, each a tall narrow vertical object viewed along its edge: Cell5 wood closed leaf, a dark brown narrow vertical edge with metal hinges; Cell6 open wood leaf swung flush to one side, edge with brass handle; Cell7 locked wood edge with prominent brass locking clasp; Cell8 thin pale-cyan crystalline edge with silver braces. The bottom row sprites must be tall slim rectangles with complete unclipped silhouettes. Each object centered within its own equal cell with at least 10% transparent gutter. No extra doors, no stairs, no arches, no skulls. All eight assets share material scale and lighting. This is an original game design, no existing franchise elements.
